--- title: >- [store.DuckDBStore]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} A vector store backed by DuckDB. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L154-L1182){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python store.DuckDBStore(con, metadata) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} DuckDBStore provides local vector storage with support for both semantic search (using embeddings) and full-text search (using BM25). Data is persisted to a DuckDB database file. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#0c43d9e6 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.store import DuckDBStore from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingOpenAI # Create a new store with embeddings store = DuckDBStore.create( location="my_store.db", embed=EmbeddingOpenAI(), ) # Insert a chunked document from raghilda.document import MarkdownDocument from raghilda.chunker import MarkdownChunker doc = MarkdownDocument( origin="https://example.com/doc1.md", content="# Example This is a sample document.", ) store.upsert(MarkdownChunker().chunk(doc)) # Build indexes before retrieval store.build_index() # Retrieve similar chunks chunks = store.retrieve("How do I use this?", top_k=5) ``` ::: ## Methods {.doc-methods}
Name Description
build_index() Build the specified index types on the embeddings table.
connect() Connect to an existing DuckDB store.
create() Create a new DuckDB store.
retrieve() Retrieve the most similar chunks to the given text.
retrieve_bm25() Retrieve chunks using BM25 full-text search.
retrieve_vss() Retrieve chunks using vector similarity search.
upsert() Upsert a document into the store.
### [build_index()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Build the specified index types on the embeddings table. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L1083-L1125){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python build_index(type=None) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [IndexType | str | list[IndexType | str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The type of index to build. Can be a single IndexType/string (`"bm25"` or `"hnsw"`) or a list of those values. If None, builds both BM25 and HNSW indexes. ::: ### [connect()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Connect to an existing DuckDB store. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L192-L245){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python connect(location=":memory:", read_only=False) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [location]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | Path]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[":memory:"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Path to the DuckDB database file. [read_only]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether to open the database in read-only mode. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [DuckDBStore]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A connected store instance. ::: ### [create()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Create a new DuckDB store. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L247-L397){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python create( location, embed, overwrite=False, name=None, title=None, attributes=None ) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [location]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | Path]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Path where the DuckDB database file will be created. [embed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [EmbeddingProvider | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Embedding provider for generating vector embeddings. If None, only full-text search will be available. [overwrite]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether to overwrite an existing database at the location. [name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Internal name for the store. [title]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Human-readable title for the store. [attributes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributesSchemaSpec | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional schema for user-defined attribute columns stored per chunk. Example: `{"tenant": str, "priority": int}`. Attribute names use identifier-style syntax. The following names are reserved and cannot be used as attributes: `chunk_id`, `context`, `embedding`, `origin`, `text`, `start_index`, `end_index`, `char_count`, `metric_name`, and `metric_value`. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [DuckDBStore]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A newly created store instance. ::: ### [retrieve()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Retrieve the most similar chunks to the given text. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L755-L830){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python retrieve(text, top_k=3, *, deoverlap=True, attributes_filter=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Combines results from vector similarity search (if embeddings are available) and BM25 full-text search, then optionally merges overlapping chunks. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [text]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The query text to search for. [top_k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[3]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The maximum number of chunks to return from each retrieval method (VSS and BM25). Because results from both methods are combined before deoverlapping, the final count may differ from `top_k`. [deoverlap]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If True (default), merge overlapping chunks from the same document. Overlapping chunks are identified by their `start_index` and `end_index` positions. When merged, the resulting chunk spans the union of the original ranges, combines metrics, and aggregates attribute values into per-chunk lists in start-order. The `context` value is kept from the first chunk in each merged overlap group. [attributes_filter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributeFilter | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional filter to scope retrieval using attribute columns. Can be a SQL-like string or a dict AST. Example string: `"tenant = 'docs' AND priority >= 2"`. Supports declared attributes plus built-in columns: `chunk_id`, `origin`, `start_index`, `end_index`, `char_count`, and `context`. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Sequence[RetrievedDuckDBMarkdownChunk]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The retrieved chunks with their relevance metrics. ::: ### [retrieve_bm25()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Retrieve chunks using BM25 full-text search. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L954-L1069){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python retrieve_bm25( query, top_k, *, k=1.2, b=0.75, conjunctive=False, attributes_filter=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Uses DuckDB's `fts` (Full-Text Search) extension for BM25 ranking. See https://duckdb.org/docs/extensions/full_text_search.html for more details. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [query]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The search query text. [top_k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The maximum number of chunks to return. [k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1.2]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : BM25 term frequency saturation parameter. Higher values increase the impact of term frequency. Default is 1.2. [b]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.75]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : BM25 length normalization parameter (0-1). Higher values penalize longer documents more. Default is 0.75. [conjunctive]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If True, all query terms must be present (AND). If False (default), any query term can match (OR). [attributes_filter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributeFilter | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional attribute filter as SQL-like string or dict AST. Supports declared attributes plus built-in columns: `chunk_id`, `origin`, `start_index`, `end_index`, `char_count`, and `context`. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[RetrievedDuckDBMarkdownChunk]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The matching chunks ranked by BM25 score. ::: ### [retrieve_vss()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Retrieve chunks using vector similarity search. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L832-L952){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python retrieve_vss( query, top_k, *, method=VSSMethod.COSINE_DISTANCE, attributes_filter=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Uses DuckDB's `vss` extension for vector similarity search. See https://duckdb.org/docs/extensions/vss.html for more details. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [query]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | Sequence[float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The query text or embedding vector. If a string is provided, it will be embedded using the store's embedding provider. [top_k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The maximum number of chunks to return. [method]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [VSSMethod]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [VSSMethod.COSINE_DISTANCE]{.doc-parameter-default} : The similarity method to use. Options are: - `COSINE_DISTANCE`: Cosine distance (default) - `EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE`: L2/Euclidean distance - `NEGATIVE_INNER_PRODUCT`: Negative dot product [attributes_filter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [AttributeFilter | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional attribute filter as SQL-like string or dict AST. Supports declared attributes plus built-in columns: `chunk_id`, `origin`, `start_index`, `end_index`, `char_count`, and `context`. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[RetrievedDuckDBMarkdownChunk]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The most similar chunks with similarity metrics. ::: #### Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If query is a string but no embedding provider is configured. ::: ### [upsert()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method} ::: {.doc-subject} Upsert a document into the store. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_duckdb_store.py#L417-L546){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python upsert(document, *, skip_if_unchanged=True) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The document must be a :py:class:`~raghilda.document.ChunkedMarkdownDocument`. Use :py:class:`~raghilda.chunker.MarkdownChunker` to chunk a :py:class:`~raghilda.document.MarkdownDocument` before upserting. ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [document]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Document]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The chunked document to upsert. [skip_if_unchanged]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If True (default), skip the write when the existing document for the same origin already has identical content and chunk layout. This avoids re-computing embeddings. :::
